text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Starting today, my trainee and I will be taking on the Twinkle Series. The Umamusume joining me for this journey is none other than…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I race exclusively for my oshis! To think that I'll be able to gaze upon the beautiful faces of my precious Umas from up close… How blessed I am!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: But of course, touching is strictly off-limits! As a self-respecting otaku, I must remember to respect the boundaries!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, <chrname> and I take our first steps towards competing in the Twinkle Series!
